name: io.github.AION-Analytics/aion-indian-market-intelligence
title: AION Indian Market Intelligence for Macro Event & Sector Impact Analysis
description: Macro-event and sector impact intelligence for Indian financial markets. Structured analysis of how policy, economic, weather, and geopolitical events affect Indian market sectors. MCP-compatible Indian market intelligence engine for macro event analysis, sector impact analysis, policy impact analysis, event-driven market intelligence, economic propagation analysis, and sector effect modeling. Requires API key.
